scope: Task15/16 bounded CLI host-auth and operator compatibility repair

requirements.requirement: Verified host identity for public CLI data operations
requirements.implementation: One per-operation SDK client, official fresh host credential callback, verified server principal+tenant+space+user pin; no URL-only identity cache; before/after each query/mutation/action delivery fence.

requirements.requirement: No saved JWT/provider credential in new public auth settings
requirements.implementation: Exclusive env-name/private file/callback selectors, private regular nonsymlink owned bounded files, token refresh rereads and bounded callback; no decoded claims or credential logging.

requirements.requirement: Failed authorization must remain a failure without deleting configuration
requirements.implementation: Authenticated session probe propagates unavailable/expired/scope change; auth/network failures preserve deployment metadata, missing actual local paths retain existing removal semantics.

requirements.requirement: Trusted operator maintenance on exact verified disposable target
requirements.implementation: Two live target checks, target-bound development key, only internal admin:getAllCounts or runtimeAuth:deleteScope, explicit tenant+space+yes retirement, bounded child and temporary secret-file cleanup.

Exact count+truncated stats; no zero fallback or mutation retry; lifecycle retirement preserves unrelated scope/tombstone/financial history; restore/full backup unsupported; private non-overwriting bounded metadata export.

limitations: This source successor is ready for installed CLI/native verification; it does not claim full Task15 or Task16 acceptance.
No build/prebuild, mirror sync, install, service/admin operation, deployment, Git mutation or paid inference was performed by this lane.
Raw CLI delivery honors returned server deliveryExpiresAt and verified session deadlines; it does not invent unreturned resource deadlines or decode JWT claims as authority.
Legacy deployment-key configuration remains historical metadata/operator compatibility; it does not authenticate the public SDK. New auth settings store only environment names/private file locations.
Generic restore and full database purge are unsupported. Backup/export is explicitly bounded authorized space/user metadata with restorable:false.
Operator counts are the exact existing internal fourteen-table response, including truncation; they do not claim a complete runtime-table inventory.
